description.value: Functional and anatomical images were realigned, unwarped, slice-time corrected, coregistered, normalized to MNI space, and smoothed.

spans.text: Preprocessing of the volumes included several procedures: coregistration of anatomical images to the standard space of the Montreal Neurological Institute brain (MNI) provided by SPM, segmentation of tissue characteristics and an affine registration into MNI, realignment to the first image and unwarping (simultaneously), slice time correction (reference slice = 13), coregistration of functional data to each participant's anatomical image, and normalization to MNI using the parameters from segmentation of the anatomical image.
